title: Label set
description: The classes a classification head decides between. The order is the order of the output logits.

labels.description: Class names, in output order. A recording whose label is not listed counts as out of set.

reject_label.description: Optional. One of `labels`: the class trained on out-of-set recordings. Never an accepted result.

held_out.description: Optional. Dataset labels kept away from training and calibration altogether, so the test split measures how the head treats classes it has never heard.
